query: What were the results on Qwen3 models?
answer: Based on the document, for the Qwen3-4B, 8B, and 14B target models, DSpark improved the macro-average accepted length over the autoregressive Eagle3 baseline by 30.9%, 26.7%, and 30.0%, respectively, and over the parallel DFlash baseline by 16.3%, 18.4%, and 18.3%, respectively [S1][S5][S7].
